notes: New Tile Look: Route, Home, Invoices, To Send, Customers, CRM, Winterization, Testing and Forecast each show summary tiles up top, with the extra buttons under the ⋯ menu.
Requests Auto-Clear: a request clears to Done by itself when its job is finished, with Undo. Several texts from the same customer merge into one card, with Unmerge.
Texts that arrive from a customer's phone now link to that customer on all your devices.
Unchecking Needs Winterization now offers to remove that address's open Winterization stops, scheduled or In Queue. Keep Stops leaves them, and Undo brings them back.
Home Stops Today now matches Route Stops Left: one address is one stop, even with a test and a Winterization there.
Address Lookup is faster and more reliable: it goes through FlowField's own server first, then the map backup.
Same-street and next-door stops stay together on one day when you Spread, Auto Spread or Re-Optimize.
The Route Miles tile says Needs 2 Stops until two stops have a map pin.
Winterization wording everywhere: the list button now says Winterization Complete, and Settings shows Winterization Reminders and Send Winterization Texts.
